evals.prompt: Integrate a new returns portal into our existing order platform on Azure. We need the cloud architecture and the portal UI, but I have not provided the repository, user roles, traffic, data classification, SLOs, routes, or API contracts.
evals.expected_output: The skill starts evidence-aware /grill discovery rather than inventing a diagram, and shapes both architecture and UI blocking questions.
expectations: Invokes the existing /grill skill in focused rounds and does not generate final diagrams before blockers are resolved or accepted as explicit assumptions.
Requests or inspects repository/IaC/frontend/API evidence before asking questions that files can answer.
Covers Azure, security, data, reliability, delivery, roles, routes, design-system reuse, screen states, accessibility, responsive behavior, UI-to-API bindings, and acceptance testing.
Does not invent exact SLOs, owners, regions, API endpoints, roles, or design-system facts.

evals.prompt: Add a responsive order-review UI specification to this React repository. It already has a private component library, tokens, route guards, TanStack Query, Zod, and Playwright. The backend architecture is already modeled.
evals.expected_output: The skill derives a repository-native UI contract and connects it to the existing architecture rather than replacing established patterns.
expectations: Inspects and reuses the repository component library, tokens, routing, query, validation, and test patterns instead of defaulting to Fluent 2.
Adds ui_spec screens, components, flows, breakpoints, states, bindings, navigation, accessibility, implementation, and analytics/privacy to the canonical model.
Links data-bound regions to real architecture components and relationships and marks any proposed API contract as proposed evidence.
Generates user-flow, compact/wide wireframe, state-map, UI specification, component matrix, acceptance plan, tokens, and interactive review artifacts.

evals.prompt: Design the technical UI spec for an enterprise admin page that can revoke access for hundreds of users in bulk. It must be safe and pass accessibility/security review.
evals.expected_output: The skill produces an implementation-ready privileged workflow with explicit safety, authorization, recovery, and accessibility contracts.
expectations: Uses /grill to resolve operator roles, approval/segregation-of-duties, blast radius, audit, rollback, partial failure, and notification requirements.
Specifies selection, review, confirmation, progress, partial-success, error, permission-denied, cancellation, and recovery states.
Every destructive action has explicit authorization and confirmation or undo/recovery behavior; the backend remains the authorization boundary.
Includes keyboard, focus, screen-reader announcement, high-contrast, zoom/reflow, and test ownership requirements.

evals.prompt: Give me a draw.io-compatible UI diagram for a customer checkout on phone and desktop, including loading, empty, error, offline, and success states. No animations.
evals.expected_output: The skill creates static draw.io and HTML-review UI diagrams driven from one responsive state contract.
expectations: Creates at least compact and wide breakpoint layouts with non-overlapping placements and stable region IDs.
Creates ui-wireframe pages for both breakpoints and a ui-state-map page with labels and legends.
Defines state content, actions, focus targets, announcements, retry/idempotency behavior, and UI-to-system bindings.
Generated HTML and UI contract contain no CSS/SVG/canvas/GIF animation or auto-advancing content.

evals.prompt: During visual review I rejected the checkout error state and requested an inline validation summary plus a retry-safe service-error panel. Apply the change without disturbing the approved architecture or other screens.
evals.expected_output: The skill applies the smallest coherent canonical-model revision, preserves stable IDs, and regenerates a traceable delta.
expectations: Preserves unrelated architecture/UI IDs, contracts, and placements.
Updates the affected state, regions/components, binding error behavior, acceptance tests, and requirement traceability together.
Runs a strict build and semantic diff; geometry-only movement is separated from semantic change.
Does not weaken or delete a governance, Kubernetes, security, or UI-quality gate to force a pass.

evals.prompt: Document the network and Kubernetes deployment architecture for a headless batch ingestion service. There is no user interface.
evals.expected_output: The skill creates the appropriate architecture pack without fabricating irrelevant UI scope.
expectations: Selects network, deployment, Kubernetes, security, data-flow, delivery, observability, and resilience views according to evidence and decisions.
Does not require or invent personas, screens, design tokens, breakpoints, UI states, or UI artifacts when UI is explicitly out of scope.
Still uses /grill for unresolved architecture blockers and applies Azure/Kubernetes gates.
Produces static labeled draw.io pages with legends and the normal architecture review bundle.
